{"title":"上海精选酒店","height":420,"css":".hd{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px 12px;flex-wrap:wrap}.hd h2{margin:0;font-size:var(--fs-lg);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em;line-height:1.3}.hd .sub{margin-top:2px;font-size:var(--fs-sm)}.hd .chips{display:flex;gap:6px}.foot{font-size:var(--fs-xs)}.ht{gap:16px}.hs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}.hs .iui-hotel-card{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--color-base-300);border-radius:var(--radius-box);background:var(--color-base-100)}.hs .iui-hotel-card .photo{height:auto;aspect-ratio:4/3;background-color:var(--color-base-200)}.hs .pick{position:absolute;left:8px;top:8px;border:0;background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--color-base-100) 90%,transparent);color:var(--color-base-content)}.hs .b{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;flex:1;padding:12px}.hs .t{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}.hs .iui-hotel-card .name{padding:0;font-size:var(--fs-sm);font-weight:500;line-height:1.4}.hs .rate{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;flex:none;font-size:var(--fs-xs);font-weight:500}.hs .area{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-size:var(--fs-xs)}.hs .tags{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap}.hs .price{margin-top:auto;padding-top:4px}.hs .price .num{font-size:var(--fs-lg);font-weight:600}.hs .price .u{font-size:var(--fs-xs)}.ht .ft{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}@media(max-width:560px){.hs{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hs .iui-hotel-card .photo{aspect-ratio:16/9}}","html":"
